articles.summary: Cells are the very fabric of our universe: Everything in this world begins and ends with cells. Technology that harnesses the innate power of cells, and their ability to expand rapidly, therefore has the potential to change the world. We are thrilled to share a new part of our journey: our recent official name change from Pluristem to Pluri. The very definition of the word explains our new vision. "Pluri" means
articles.title: Pluri: Where Technology Comes to Life
